result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in Sfax due to Routing Policy Update on AGG-SFX-02

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-02`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of a config push on AGG-SFX-02 matches the exact timing of the KPI drops and site alarms, with changes checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-15 12:30 to 2026-09-15 17:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-15 12:19
- **Affected:** S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010

## Summary

A configuration push for a routing policy update was executed on AGG-SFX-02, disrupting routing for dependent sites S-SFX-008 and S-SFX-010.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on two sites in Sfax (S-SFX-008 and S-SFX-010) starting around 12:30 and recovering by 17:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-15 12:19: Config push CHG-2026-0042 executed on AGG-SFX-02. [CHG-2026-0042]
- 2026-09-15 12:30: Traffic and availability drop detected across S-SFX-008 and S-SFX-010. [ALR-0015, ANM-000175]
- 2026-09-15 12:45: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SFX-010 and S-SFX-008. [ALM-000242, ALM-000243]
- 2026-09-15 17:39: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-008. [ALM-000243]
- 2026-09-15 17:41: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-010. [ALM-000242]
- 2026-09-15 17:45: Alert ALR-0015 for SFX region sites ended. [ALR-0015]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SFX-008 and S-SFX-010 experienced an alert for traffic, active users, and availability drops starting at 12:30. [ALR-0015]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-SFX-010 and S-SFX-008 at 12:45 and cleared around 17:40. [ALM-000242, ALM-000243]
- A configuration push CHG-2026-0042 occurred on AGG-SFX-02 at 12:19 for a routing policy update. [CHG-2026-0042]
- Topology shows both S-SFX-008 and S-SFX-010 depend on the shared fiber link LNK-SFX-02-A and aggregation router AGG-SFX-02. [T5, T6]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010, or their parents. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-02: confirmed. A routing policy update config push directly preceded the site drops and matched the exact failure domain. [CHG-2026-0042, ALR-0015]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-02-A: rejected. No fiber cut alarms were recorded on the shared link, and a configuration change was found on the aggregation router instead. [CHG-2026-0042, T8]

## Ruled out

- T4: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites and their ancestors during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review the routing policy update logic in CHG-2026-0042 to prevent future routing loops or drops.
- Improve pre-check validation for configuration pushes on aggregation routers.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0042`: config_push on AGG-SFX-02 at 2026-09-15 12:19: Routing policy update on AGG-SFX-02
- `ALR-0015`: ended alert from 2026-09-15 12:30: 2 site(s) (S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010); region-level SFX; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb
- `ANM-000175`: S-SFX-008 availability_pct drop, z -100.0, baseline 100 -> 0
- `ALM-000242`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SFX-010, raised 2026-09-15 12:45, cleared 2026-09-15 17:41
- `ALM-000243`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SFX-008, raised 2026-09-15 12:45, cleared 2026-09-15 17:39
- `T5`: get_topology(node_id=S-SFX-008, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SFX-008 (site) -> LNK-SFX-02-A (fiber link) -> AGG-SFX-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-02 (core upf)
- `T6`: get_topology(node_id=S-SFX-010, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SFX-010 (site) -> LNK-SFX-02-A (fiber link) -> AGG-SFX-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-02 (core upf)
- `T4`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-15 11:00, end=2026-09-15 19:00, node_ids=['S-SFX-008', 'S-SFX-010'], include_ancestors=True) -> No maintenance window scheduled on S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010 and its parents between 2026-09-15 11:00 and 2026-09-15 19:00.
- `T8`: get_changes(start=2026-09-15 11:00, end=2026-09-15 13:00, node_ids=['LNK-SFX-02-A'], include_ancestors=True) -> 1 change(s) on LNK-SFX-02-A and its parents, 2026-09-15 11:00 to 2026-09-15 13:00 (1 on upstream nodes, 0 rolled back by asked_at 2026-09-16 08:43).

confounders.why: Harmless config_push on AGG-SFX-02 25 min before the cut; the sibling links under the same router were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Fibre cut on LNK-SFX-02-A; all 2 downstream sites lost service until repair. Trap: a config_push on AGG-SFX-02, the router above the link, ran 25 min before the cut, so a hasty investigator blames the router change. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS (no light, critical) on LNK-SFX-02-A is a physical fault that no router change explains; (2) only the sites of LNK-SFX-02-A went down while the sites of LNK-SFX-02-B, under the same router, stayed at 100 % availability; (3) the KPIs were normal between the change and the cut.
